content.value: A city requires 100 MeV of electrical power on an average. If this is to be supplied by a nuclear reactor of efficiency 20% using U-235 as the nuclear fuel, calculate the amount of fuel required for one day's operation. Given that energy released per fusion of U-235 nuclide= 200 MeV.
